name: sentinel
description: Self-hosted backup orchestrator for web projects: scheduled backups of databases (Turso, MySQL via SSH) and storage (Vercel Blob, SFTP) with a dashboard.
author: Steven Dieu

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.prod: npm run build && pm2 restart sentinel
